description: Marine forecast for boaters (NWS) — US coastal marine forecast for boaters from the National Weather Service: finds the NWS marine zone for a point on the water (lat=&lon=, or place=, or zone= like ANZ338), then parses every period into wind direction, sustained and gust knots, wave height and period, hazards (thunderstorms, fog, gale, freezing spray) and a condition level CALM / MODERATE / SMALL CRAFT CONDITIONS / GALE / STORM. Adds active marine alerts (Small Craft Advisory, Gale Warning...), a GO / CAUTION / NO-GO verdict against your limits (max_wind_kt= default 15, max_wave_ft= default 3) and the best window of periods within them. Example: /v1/weather/marine?lat=40.52&lon=-73.98. Public-domain NOAA data. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_marine
